metadata.title: Homological lifts of Arnold strangeness
metadata.abstract: We construct homological lifts of Arnold's strangeness $\operatorname{St}$ for long and closed plane curves. For long curves, we introduce a new $q$-variable quantization polynomial $\operatorname{St}_q$, an edge state sum, designed for categorification and construct a triply graded homology that recovers $\operatorname{St}_q$. We prove strictness by exhibiting long curves with the same number of crossings and the same $\operatorname{St}_q$ (in particular, the same rotation number and $\operatorname{St}$) that are distinguished by the homology. For closed curves, we introduce a corresponding new polynomial $\operatorname{St}_q$ and construct an edge homology. In this case $\operatorname{St}_q$ is recovered from a signed $q$-character $\operatorname{ch}_q$ defined on the canonical cycles of the homology rather than directly from a graded rank. Again, we exhibit closed curves with the same number of crossings and the same $\operatorname{St}_q$ (in particular, the same rotation number and $\operatorname{St}$) that are distinguished by the homology.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 曲线不变量的同调提升
analysis.workSummary: 作者为长平面曲线和闭平面曲线构造 Arnold strangeness 的同调提升：长曲线引入边状态和量子多项式 St_q 并构造恢复它的三重分次同调；闭曲线则构造边同调，从典范循环上的带符号 q-character 恢复 St_q。两类都展示交叉数及 St_q 相同而同调可区分的实例。
techniques: 边状态和与 q 量子化
典范循环上的带符号 q-character
analysis.breakthrough: 同调提升在区分曲线方面严格强于相应多项式，从而也超越仅旋转数和 Arnold strangeness 的信息。
analysis.limitations: 闭曲线的多项式从指定典范循环的 character 恢复，而非简单取分次秩；两类构造不能混写。结果属于平面曲线拓扑不变量，不是曲率或曲线流的分析估计。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
